messages:
Hannah (Support): P1 - Vireo Health trial users abruptly lost access to embeddings and chat during onboarding. Customer seeing 403s & SSO errors after we attempted a seat swap. Theyre pushing pause on the pilot and mentioned renewal talk tomorrow. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-9991 :rotating_light:

Hannah (Support): Minimal log from proxy: 
```text
403 Forbidden - invalid_token or quota_exceeded
org: org-vireo-90
operation: embed.generate
user_count: 17
quota_limit: 15
sso_status: token_exchange_failed
```

Diego (CS): Looping @Aria and @Logan. I just spoke to Alex at Vireo; they did a seat transfer from "data-team" to "analytics" but some sessions started failing immediately. We need a quick unblock + short comms. Renewal at risk if unmet by tomorrow. :grimacing:

Aria (AM): Looking now. Billing shows a pending invoice hold due to mismatched PO numbers which blocked the seat-change workflow. I can authorize an emergency seat swap in-system once SRE confirms it's safe. ETA from legal unclear (~1-2 business days).

Logan (SRE): Technically we can do two things fast: 1) revert the seat-swap to previous state (safe) via admin rollback, or 2) temporarily escalate org quota to 30 to tolerate spikes. Rollback command:
```bash
redwood-admin seats rollback --org org-vireo-90 --from analytics --to data-team --job "rollback-4122223333"
```
Quota bump example:
```bash
redwood-admin quota set --org org-vireo-90 --limit 30 --ttl 24h --note "temp unblock - seat-swap fallout"
```
Rollback is preferred to avoid billing anomalies.

Hannah (Support): Customer is asking for the fastest option, they just reported 10 blocked users in last hour. Alex said: "We can't demo tomorrow if this isn't fixed today."

Diego (CS): Proposed comms to Alex (short):
"Alex - sorry for the interruption. We're preparing an immediate rollback of the seat change to restore your team's access; if you'd prefer a temporary quota boost instead, say so and we'll apply it for 24h. We'll reconcile billing with you after legal clears the PO. ETA: rollback within 30m. - Diego"

Aria (AM): I'll pre-approve the rollback. If they want a quota bump instead, I'll sign off on a 24h seat loan and open billing task BILL-5550 for reconciliation. Finance bot looped.

finance-bot: Acknowledged. Temporary seat loans create prorated adjustments; BILL-5550 created and assigned to billing-ops. AM approval required (noted).

Logan (SRE): I'll run rollback now and post job id. If rollback fails or partial, we'll fall back to quota bump. Running: 
```bash
redwood-admin seats rollback --org org-vireo-90 --from analytics --to data-team --job "rollback-4122223333" --async
```
Job started: job-89234

Hannah (Support): Copying job id to INC-9991 and attaching recent HAR. Marking support action in progress.

Logan (SRE): Rollback completed. job-89234 status: success. Confirmed ~16 users reconnected. No errors in post-checks.

Diego (CS): Update to Alex sent: "Rollback complete; please confirm you can access embeddings and chat. We're standing by to apply a short quota bump if any remaining users are blocked. - Diego"

Hannah (Support): Customer replied: "Access restored, thanks. Please keep us posted on billing. We'll hold the renewal conversation but want a note that this caused friction."

Diego (CS): Action items: 1) Aria to follow up with billing/legal to resolve PO mismatch and confirm reconciliation timeline. 2) Flag renewal risk in Gainsight (medium-high) and schedule a 30m post-mortem with customer + AM + CS. 3) Add an onboarding note to their account about the seat-swap risk. I'll own comms and the post-mortem scheduling.

Aria (AM): Will escalate PO mismatch to procurement sponsor and loop finance. Sending message now and creating escalation TASK-2241. If legal >48h, propose 24h seat loan as contingency.

finance-bot: TASK-2241 created; billing ops assigned. Reminder: any manual seat loan must be invoiced and reconciled once PO clears.

Hannah (Support): Closing the support incident after confirming customer access. Leaving the thread for CS/AM follow-up. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
